privacyPolicyContent.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyContent.introduction: Welcome to TRYRECRUITERS! Your privacy is important to us. This Confidentiality Agreement ("Agreement") explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you use the TRYRECRUITERS Web. By creating an account and using the App, you agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in this Agreement.

subsection1.title: 1.1 Information You Provide to Us:
items: Account Information: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, password, CV, and other necessary information.
Profile Information: You can choose to add additional information to your profile such as a profile picture, phone number, and other details.
Content: Any information or content that you provide, upload, or share through the App, such as messages, posts, and multimedia files.

subsection2.title: 1.2 Information We Collect Automatically:
items: Device Information: We collect information about the device you use to access the App, including hardware models, operating systems, and unique device identifiers.
Usage Information: We collect information about your interactions with the App, such as access times, pages viewed, and actions taken.
Location Information: We may collect information about your location via your IP address, GPS, or other location-based technologies if you use these services.

subsection1.title: 2.1 To Provide and Improve Our Services:
items: To create and manage your account.
To personalize your experience and provide content and features tailored to your interests and profile.
To respond to your comments, questions, and provide tailored customer service.

subsection2.title: 2.2 For Communication:
items: To send you technical notices, updates, security alerts, and support messages.
To provide you with information about new features, services, and promotions.

subsection3.title: 2.3 For Security and Fraud Prevention:
items: To monitor and analyze usage and activities to ensure the security of the App.
To detect, prevent, and address fraud, unauthorized activities, and access.

subsection4.title: 2.4 Legal Compliance:
items: To comply with legal obligations, enforce our agreements, and protect the rights, property, and safety of TRYRECRUITERS, our users, and others.

subsection1.title: 3.1 With Service Providers:
subsection1.description: We may share your information with third-party vendors, consultants, and other service providers who need access to your information to perform work on our behalf.

subsection2.title: 3.2 For Legal Reasons:
subsection2.description: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to a legal request, such as a court order, subpoena, or government investigation or tax authority.

subsection3.title: 3.3 Business Transfers:
subsection3.description: We may share or transfer your information in connection with, during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company.

subsection1.title: 4.1 Access and Update:
subsection1.description: You can access and update your personal information through your account settings.

subsection2.title: 4.2 Delete Account:
subsection2.description: You can delete your account at any time, which will remove your profile and associated data from our systems.

subsection3.title: 4.3 Unsubscribe:
subsection3.description: You can opt out of receiving promotional communications from us by following the instructions in those communications or through your account settings.

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.description: We implement various security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.description: We retain your personal information as long as necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Agreement unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

section7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
section7.description: Our App is not intended for children under 18 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we become aware that we have inadvertently received personal information from a user under 18, we will delete such information from our records.

section8.title: 8. Changes to This Confidentiality Agreement
section8.description: We may update this Confidentiality Agreement from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new Confidentiality Agreement on the App and updating the "Effective Date" at the top of this Agreement. Your continued use of the App after any changes to this Confidentiality Agreement constitutes your acceptance of the revised Agreement.

section9.description: If you have any questions about this Confidentiality Agreement, please contact us at info@tryrecruiters.com.
